footer.text: Want to try this for yourself? Try the local version of pollen designed to run with Apple MLX and make your own pollinators, mix them etc.

cards.title: what's 2+2?
cards.subtitle: different answers to a straightforward question. is pollen even necessary here?

cards.title: when did the war end?
cards.subtitle: specifying who answers a question will influence the answer maybe even more than you think. pick your pollinators but pick them wisely.

cards.title: what's the nature of the universe?
cards.subtitle: what if we crosspolinated answers under the hood? does it change the answer?
cards.explainer: The word probabilities from each pollinators have been combined in a way that their agreement (common ground) is amplified. Wherever each pollinator shows higher probability for a word that word is more likely to be picked in the mixed answer.

cards.title: why is art important to humans?
cards.subtitle: will amplifying disagreement between divergent views make for a more compelling answer?
cards.explainer: The word probabilities from each pollinator have been combined in a way that wherever one shows stark preference of a word over the other, that word is more likely to make it in the mixed answer.
